response.overview: Over the course of one summer, Bêka & Lemoine settled in the park to observe this global microcosm from within. Throughout the film,  they explore how the neighbourhood is shaped by migration, religion, and politics — a diversity that can often generate tensions and  contradictions, but also unexpected encounters. The film questions how a public space can foster coexistence and enable people to  collectively inhabit and redefine a shared place. The World in a Square composes a choral portrait of a community marked by contrasts  and constant transformation, reflecting the broader evolution of Danish society.
response.title: The World in a Square
